result: Original BIOS handed off through the normal MediaSet loader; original guest wrote 0x42 to 0x6000 in two frames. This is header/entry validation, not mapper or commercial-game qualification.
fixture_correction: The old application fixtures used raw 0x5A images. They now have AA55 headers and read payload byte 0x8002, preserving the mapping, reset, variant switch and source-removal invariants.
raw_insertion: Public signature unchanged; raw diagnostic insertion and existing raw snapshots remain supported.
